items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: They were so happy to see Jaw you know.

ctx.x: That’s a great way to make people come to work too, man.
And they really played, because they wanted to impress him. They were so happy to see Jaw you know.
Oh it was a rush, you could feel it you know, a beautiful rush. Really wild.
